title: Core Trio #14
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, sultry, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif — a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Left woman's footwear: extreme silver extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult French woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, long dark-brown hair in an effortless tousled updo, an unbothered, effortless expression, sultry, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Escher-inspired tessellation — a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.

Center woman's footwear: extreme gold thigh-high stiletto boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, sultry, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
